title: Rabbi Shimon of Katzetor
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin identifies the Rabbi Shimon of [Nazir 52b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.52b.6), who says of Rabbi Akiva, “Whether Rabbi Akiva retracted after he died, I do not know,” as Rabbi Shimon of Katzetor. Hyman says that this name is not found in the Gemara editions he consulted.

notes.text: The linked Gemara quotes Rabbi Shimon wondering about a retraction after Rabbi Akiva died. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Nazir.52b.6.3) explains the remark as disparaging. The proposed identification is Yuchasin’s, as reported by Hyman. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3440&lang=en) also records this identification as a reported view, and phrases it as a retraction only after Rabbi Akiva’s death.
